(Japanese: '''ポケモンコロシアム スナッチャーズ''' ''Pokémon Colosseum Snatchers'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] created by [[Oouchi Suigun]]. It is an adaptation of [[Pokémon Colosseum]]. It is not to be confused with [[Pokémon Colosseum Snatcher Leo]], another manga by Suigun based on the same game, which ran in a different magazine.

==Publications==
Pokémon Colosseum Snatchers was originally serialized over three [[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comic]] issues, from December 2003 to February 2004. Since the completion of its original magazine run, the manga has not been republished in volume format anywhere in the world.

==Differences between the manga and the game==
* The trainer with the two {{p|Zigzagoon}} at the start looks like a {{tc|Bodybuilder}} rather than {{tc|Rider}} [[Willie]] .
* [[Rui]] is kidnapped at [[Outskirt Stand]] rather than [[Phenac City]].
* {{p|Bayleef}}, {{p|Quilava}} and {{p|Croconaw}} are owned by a thug rather than [[Verde]], [[Rosso]] and [[Bluno]].
* [[Wes]] captures {{p|Bayleef}} at [[Outskirt Stand]] rather than at [[Phenac City]], [[Snagem Hideout]] or [[Shadow PKMN Lab]].
* Wes owns a pair of {{p|Ludicolo}}, two Pokémon that are unobtainable in Pokémon Colosseum without trading.
